// diagnostic

E0335

A bare `{ }` follows a call.

What

A bare `{ }` follows a call.

Why

Code arguments are ordinary `() -> { … }` lambdas inside the call's parentheses (D-TRAILBLOCK2). Trailing `{ }` sugar after a call is gone.

Fix

Write `callee(() -> { … })`. Put each statement on its own line inside the block.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0335: tests/ui/marker_wrong_at_plane.stderr.

Error [E0335]: trailing blocks are gone — pass code with `() ->`
  --> tests/ui/marker_wrong_at_plane.jet:2:35
    |
  2 |     @Unsafe("raw pointer access") {
    |                                   ^
 Why: a bare `{ }` after a call used to fill one last zero-parameter function argument; that sugar is retired (D-TRAILBLOCK2)
 Fix: write `callee(…, () -> { … })` — put the block inside the parentheses as `() -> { … }`
